intro: The suitcase is unpacked, but the curiosity isn't. This is where I collect possibilities, explore routes, and share the plans that eventually turn into postcards.

ideas.title: Japan
ideas.description: A journey through Japan is high on my list—its cities, mountain scenery, historic places, and a culture I would love to experience.

ideas.title: Southeast Asia
ideas.description: Thailand, Vietnam, and perhaps other parts of Asia: new landscapes, fascinating cities, local food, and places I have yet to discover.

ideas.title: Northern Europe
ideas.description: Sweden, Norway, and perhaps more of the Nordic region—especially the dramatic landscapes, fjords, and scenery farther north.

ideas.title: Costa Rica
ideas.description: A Central American adventure with lush rainforests, volcanoes, wildlife, and beautiful natural scenery.
